test_objective: Check temporal pagination is applied when querying the temporal evolution of entities via POST

test_cases.name: 021_16_01 retrieve the entities via post
test_cases.doc: Check that temporal pagination is triggered on the post temporal query
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entityOperations/query'
        method set to 'POST'
        Query Temporal Representation of Entities Via POST Request: and
    Query Parameter: query_file_name set to '${payload_file}' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json'
}
